blocks.text: Hassle-Free Old Mattress Pickup & Disposal Company

c: A mattress is the most awkward object in any home. It’s not the heaviest thing you own, but it’s the floppiest — a queen fights back on every stair, folds the wrong way at every corner, and turns a two-minute hallway into a twenty-minute negotiation. And once it’s finally out, the problem changes shape: most charities won’t accept used mattresses, curbside programs have strict rules and set-out schedules, and a mattress leaning against the garage wall has a way of staying there for a season.

Our mattress removal crews close the whole loop in one visit. We come to the bedroom — second floor, basement, or twentieth-floor condo — and carry out the mattress, box spring, and frame with the technique and straps the job actually requires. From there, everything is routed the right way: steel springs, foam, and fibres to mattress recycling, metal frames to scrap processing, and only the unrecyclable remainder to disposal. Homeowners, renters, and landlords across the Greater Toronto Area book us with a free quote — usually timed to the day the new mattress arrives, so the old one never has anywhere to linger.

blocks.text: Same-Day Mattress Haul Away — Timed to Your New Bed's Delivery

c: Mattress removals are the most deadline-shaped job we do, because almost every one is triggered by a delivery. The new bed arrives Thursday between noon and four — which means the old one must be gone Thursday morning, or two mattresses will be sharing a bedroom built for one. Our scheduling is designed around exactly this: same-day and next-day slots across the GTA, morning pickups ahead of afternoon deliveries, and evening windows for beds that can’t leave until after work.

We take every piece of the sleep setup: mattresses in every size from twin to California king, box springs and foundations, metal and wooden bed frames, headboards and footboards, and adjustable bases with their motors and hardware. Condition is irrelevant — sagging, stained, torn, or waterlogged mattresses ride the same truck. If a mattress is coming out of a suspected bed bug situation, tell us when booking: we arrive with sealed mattress bags, encase it before it moves an inch, and keep the rest of your home protected on the way out.
Pricing is flat and quoted in writing up front — a single mattress, a full bed set, or every bed in the house before a move.
New mattress already on the truck?
Call us now at +1 647 922 5865 or book online at LiveJunkFree.ca.

blocks.text: In-Home Bed & Box Spring Removal – Any Room, Any Floor, Any Size

c: The physics of a mattress are why this service exists. A king weighs well over a hundred pounds and bends like a wet playing card; a box spring is rigid in exactly the ways the staircase isn’t; and pillow-top queens absorb years of humidity until they’re heavier than the day they arrived. Add a switchback staircase, a narrow condo hallway, or a basement bedroom, and “just drag it out” becomes a two-person technical job with real strain-injury potential.

Live Junk Free crews do this dozens of times a week across every GTA housing type: kids’ twins from upstairs bedrooms, guest-room doubles, primary-suite kings that barely made it in, bunk and trundle setups, and rental-property turnovers where every bedroom empties at once. Landlords, short-term-rental hosts, and hotels use us for multi-mattress swaps; families use us for the one stubborn queen.

The service is genuinely door-to-done. We bring the straps, protect railings and wall corners along the route, flex the mattress through the tight spots the way the pros do, disassemble frames and adjustable bases where needed, and load everything in one trip. If the new mattress delivery crew has been and gone, we’ll even slide the boxed newcomer into the bedroom on our way out — it’s a small thing, but it’s the kind of small thing people remember.

items: Full sleep-set pickup – Mattress, box spring, frame, headboard, and adjustable base, from whichever room they’re in
Recycling-first handling – Springs, foam, fibre, and frame metals diverted to recyclers, with sealed-bag protocols for bed bug cases

items: Booking takes a photo and an address; arrival takes a scheduled window, not a vague “sometime today.” The crew walks the route first — stairs, turns, doorways — pads the contact points, then flexes, straps, and carries the mattress and box spring out, disassembling the frame behind them if it’s going too.

Most single-set pickups are complete inside twenty minutes, ending with the bedroom swept of dust bunnies the bed was hiding and, if your new mattress is waiting boxed in the hall, moved into place before we go.

items.q: 1) Do you take the box spring and bed frame too, or just the mattress?
a: Everything, under one flat quote — mattress, box spring or foundation, frame, headboard, footboard, and adjustable bases including their motors. Frames are disassembled by our crew as part of the job, so the bedroom is left completely clear.

items.q: 2) Can you remove a mattress from an upstairs bedroom or a condo?
a: That’s the core of the service. Crews carry from wherever the bed sits — second-floor rooms, finished basements, or high-rise units, where we’ll coordinate the service elevator with your building. Railings, corners, and hallways are padded along the route.

items.q: 3) What happens to my old mattress after pickup?
a: It’s recycled wherever the materials allow. Steel coils and frame metal go to scrap recovery, and foam and fibre layers are diverted for industrial reuse — keeping one of the bulkiest possible items out of landfill. Soiled or bed bug mattresses are sealed and disposed of through proper channels instead.

items.q: 4) I think my mattress has bed bugs — will you still take it?
a: Yes, with precautions. Mention it when booking and the crew arrives with sealed mattress encasement bags, wraps the mattress before it moves, and routes it out without contact with your walls or other rooms. Sealed units go straight to disposal, never anywhere near donation or recycling reuse streams.

items.q: 5) How much does mattress removal cost, and is same-day really possible?
a: Pricing is flat and quoted in writing from a single photo — with set rates covering the full mattress-box-spring-frame combination and discounts as bed count grows. Same-day pickup is genuinely routine across the GTA; most customers book the morning slot ahead of an afternoon mattress delivery.

blocks.text: Common Questions About Mattress Removal Services

c: Getting rid of an old mattress can be difficult because mattresses are bulky, heavy, and often require special disposal or recycling. Below are answers to common questions about mattress removal costs, pickup, preparation, disposal, recycling, and hiring a professional mattress removal service in the GTA.

items.q: Read What People Ask About Mattress Removal Services
a: 1. How much does it cost to have a mattress removed?

The cost depends on the mattress size, pickup location, accessibility, and whether other items are being removed at the same time. A professional junk removal company can provide a quote based on the specific job.
2. Is there an extra charge for removing a box spring along with the mattress?

A box spring may be included in the same removal service, but pricing depends on the company’s rates and the total amount being removed. Mention both the mattress and box spring when requesting a quote.
3. Do junk removal companies charge by weight or by the size of the mattress?
Many junk removal companies consider the amount of space items take up in the truck rather than charging strictly by weight. Mattress size, quantity, labor, and access can all affect the price.
4. What is the cheapest way to get rid of an old mattress?

The cheapest option depends on your municipality and available disposal programs. Free municipal collection, mattress recycling programs, retailer take-back services, or donating a usable mattress may cost less than hiring a private removal company.
5. Are there hidden fees for mattress disposal, like environmental or recycling taxes?

Some disposal or recycling programs may charge separate fees, while others include them in their pricing. Always ask whether transportation, labor, recycling, and disposal costs are included in the quoted price.
6. Do mattress removal prices change for king-size versus twin-size beds?
They can. Larger mattresses generally take up more truck space and may require more handling, so the removal price can vary by mattress size.
7. Is it cheaper to hire a private service or use city bulk trash pickup?

Municipal bulk collection may be less expensive if your area offers mattress pickup, but it can have specific scheduling and preparation requirements. A private junk removal company can be more convenient when you need the mattress removed from inside your home or on a specific date.
8. Do any companies offer free mattress removal near me?

Free mattress removal may be available through municipal programs, retailers, charities, or local recycling initiatives, depending on your area. Private junk removal services generally charge for labor, transportation, and disposal.
9. How much does 1-800-GOT-JUNK charge just for a single mattress?

Pricing from large junk removal companies can vary by location, availability, mattress size, and the amount of space used in the truck. It is best to request a current quote for your specific pickup rather than relying on a general online estimate.
10. Are there senior or student discounts available for junk removal services?
Discounts depend on the individual company. If you qualify for a senior or student discount, ask about available promotions when requesting your mattress removal quote.
11. Do I need to wrap my mattress in plastic before the movers arrive?

Not usually for a standard mattress pickup, but preparation requirements vary by disposal or collection program. If the mattress has stains, moisture, pests, or other issues, tell the removal company before the appointment.
12. Will mattress removal services go upstairs to pick it up from my bedroom?
Many full-service junk removal companies can remove mattresses from bedrooms, including those located upstairs. Stairs, narrow hallways, elevators, and difficult access may affect the labor involved.
13. Can I leave the mattress on the curb for a contactless pickup?

Some companies can collect items from a curb or driveway if this is arranged in advance. Confirm the pickup instructions and make sure the mattress is placed somewhere accessible and protected from weather.
14. Do I have to be home at the exact time of the mattress pickup?
Not necessarily. Some removal services can complete a pickup without you being present if access and instructions have been arranged beforehand.
15. How long does it take to schedule a mattress removal appointment?
Appointment availability depends on the company’s schedule and your location. Many junk removal companies offer flexible scheduling, while urgent or same-day appointments depend on crew availability.
16. Can I get same-day mattress removal if I call in the morning?
Same-day mattress removal may be available when a local crew has an open appointment. Contact the company as early as possible and provide the mattress size, quantity, and pickup location.
17. What should I do if my mattress has stains or tears? Will they still take it?
A stained or damaged mattress may still be accepted for removal, but its condition can affect whether it can be donated or recycled. Tell the removal company about significant damage before pickup.
18. Do they remove bed frames and headboards at the same time?

Many junk removal companies can remove bed frames, headboards, box springs, and other bedroom furniture along with the mattress. Including all items in the initial quote helps the crew prepare for the job.
19. Will junk removal teams disassemble my adjustable bed base?

Some companies can dismantle and remove certain bed bases, but adjustable bases can contain electrical components and mechanical parts. Provide details about the model and condition before scheduling removal.
20. How do I prepare a mattress for a curbside collection service?

Follow your municipality’s collection instructions regarding placement, wrapping, timing, and weather protection. Keep the mattress accessible to the collection crew and separate from materials that are not accepted.
21. Will junk removal companies take a mattress with bed bugs?

Many junk removal companies have restrictions on mattresses or upholstered furniture affected by bed bugs. Always disclose a known or suspected infestation before the crew arrives so the company can determine whether it can safely accept the item.
22. Do I have to disclose a bed bug infestation before the team arrives?
Yes. If a mattress has or may have bed bugs, tell the removal company in advance. This allows the company to follow its safety and handling procedures and determine the appropriate removal option.
23. What are the legal rules for dumping a mattress in my city?

Mattress disposal rules vary by municipality and waste facility. Some areas require mattresses to be placed out separately, taken to a designated facility, or sent through a recycling program rather than placed with regular household garbage.
24. Can I be fined for putting a mattress next to a standard dumpster?

Potentially, depending on local waste rules and whether the dumpster accepts bulky items. Never assume a mattress can be left beside a dumpster; check the property’s waste policy or local disposal requirements first.
25. Are there specific laws about transporting an old mattress on top of a car?

Transporting a mattress improperly secured to a vehicle can create a serious road-safety hazard and may violate applicable transportation rules. If you transport one yourself, follow local requirements for securely containing and fastening the load.
26. Does my landlord have to pay for mattress removal when I move out?

This depends on the lease, rental agreement, property rules, and circumstances surrounding the mattress. Check your agreement and ask your landlord or property manager before assuming removal is their responsibility.
27. Why do some garbage trucks refuse to take mattresses with regular trash?

Mattresses are bulky and contain materials that can be difficult to process through standard garbage collection systems. Many municipalities therefore use separate bulk-item collection or mattress recycling programs.
28. Do I need a special permit to drop off a mattress at the local landfill?
Requirements vary by waste facility and municipality. Some facilities accept mattresses directly while others require specific disposal arrangements, fees, or recycling procedures.
29. Where can I donate a mattress that is still in good condition?

Donation options depend on the mattress’s age, cleanliness, condition, and the organization’s acceptance policy. Contact local charities or reuse organizations before transporting the mattress to confirm they accept used mattresses.
30. Do charities like Salvation Army or Goodwill pick up used mattresses?

Charity policies vary by location, and many organizations have restrictions on accepting used mattresses because of hygiene and safety concerns. Contact the specific local branch before arranging a donation pickup.
31. How much of a mattress can actually be recycled?

A mattress contains materials such as steel, foam, wood, and textiles that can potentially be separated and recycled. The amount recovered depends on the mattress construction and the recycling facility processing it.
32. Where is the nearest mattress recycling drop-off center?
Mattress recycling locations vary throughout the GTA. Before making a trip, check the facility’s current acceptance rules, hours, fees, and whether appointments are required.
33. Does buying a new mattress include free removal of the old one?

Some mattress retailers offer old-mattress removal or recycling when delivering a replacement, while others charge an additional fee. Ask about the retailer’s haul-away policy before purchasing a new mattress.
34. Which mattress brands offer free mattress recycling with a new purchase?
Take-back and recycling policies vary by retailer, brand, and location. Check the current delivery and recycling terms when purchasing a replacement mattress rather than assuming removal is included.
35. How do I break down a mattress myself to throw it away in pieces?

Mattresses contain springs, foam, fabric, and other materials that can be difficult and potentially unsafe to dismantle. Before cutting one apart, check your local disposal rules and consider using a mattress recycling or professional removal service instead.
36. Can you post a used mattress on Facebook Marketplace or Craigslist for free?

You may be able to offer a clean, usable mattress through a local marketplace, subject to the platform’s current rules. Be honest about its age and condition, and clearly disclose any stains, damage, or other issues.
37. What is the best junk removal service for mattress disposal?

The best service depends on your location, price, availability, accepted items, and disposal practices. Compare reviews, insurance, pricing transparency, and whether the company handles mattresses through appropriate recycling or disposal channels.
38. How do I compare local mattress haul-away reviews?

Look for recent reviews that specifically mention mattress removal, pickup timing, pricing, communication, and how the crew handled the property. Reviews describing similar residential jobs are generally more useful than ratings alone.
39. Are private mattress removal companies insured against property damage?

Many professional junk removal companies carry liability insurance, but coverage varies. Ask the company about its insurance before booking, particularly when the crew needs to remove a mattress through stairs, hallways, or tight spaces.
40. Should I hire a local handyman or a national chain for mattress pickup?

A handyman may be suitable for certain small removal jobs, while a professional junk removal company is typically focused specifically on hauling, recycling, and disposal. Compare availability, pricing, insurance, reviews, and disposal practices before choosing.
41. What is the difference between bulk trash pickup and professional junk removal?

Bulk trash pickup is usually a municipal service with specific collection dates, placement rules, and accepted items. Professional junk removal provides a scheduled crew that typically handles the lifting, loading, hauling, and disposal for you.
